decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of the original permission 01217/121/P2 dated 24/01/2017.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (W003-FLAT-FULLPP- 00, 01, 01A, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06.R1, 07.R1, 08.R1, and 09/R1 Received 3 March 2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The refuse storage arrangements as shown on the plans hereby approved shall be installed and available for use prior to the first occupation of the units.

Condition : 6 - The cycle storage arrangements as shown on the plans hereby approved shall be installed and available for use prior to the first occupation of the units and permanently retained thereafter.
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to allow for modification to the approved design following planning permission 01217/121/P2 dated 24/1/2017 for replacement of existing conservatory with single storey rear extension, alterations to existing rear extension and flat conversion from single dwelling house into two one-bedroom flats and two two-bedroom flats.
